semanticEnrichment.description: TEXT. FK → plants.SiteKey. Links to parent solar plant.

JSONB column. Captures tracker status, glass / back-sheet health, electrical connections and cleaning history for a panel string or block at a given snapshot, allowing O&M teams to query a single JSONB field for mechanical diagnostics.
TIMESTAMP. Timestamp when snapshot was taken. Example: 43315.51482.

Represents a time-stamped mechanical-health snapshot for a solar plant, capturing tracker status, module surface condition, electrical connection integrity, and mount/cleaning history via a single JSONB payload.
